decisions.reason: The signature scope change does not alter the allocated-budget requirement; its JHS 157 value and scope are already independently established by the allocated-budget clause in the same message.
The signature scope change does not alter the service-schedule requirement; the JHS 157 schedule values and scope are already independently established by the schedule clause in the same message.
The signature scope change does not cause a separate change to the support-sheet requirement; that requirement already has a same-message scope extension to JHS 157 based on its own explicit clause.
